Create or validate a view of an applied household-income result

Source: R/liss_source_nonresponse_applied_view.R
liss_create_applied_income_view.Rd

Select and reorder already-computed rows from a valid whole s339 applied result in correct or na_only mode. The exact complete parent, including original native schema-4 source_input, stays in parent_result. Creation and structural validation project existing output without cleaning or fitting. The separately pinned view policy and lineage are version 1.0.0; the native carrier remains version 4.0.0 and whole-parent lineage remains version 1.0.0.

Usage

liss_create_applied_income_view(parent_result, row_keys)

liss_validate_applied_income_view(view, replay = FALSE)

Arguments

parent_result

complete result accepted by liss_validate_applied_income(), with native schema-4 source input.

row_keys

required plain ordered unique character vector of parent row keys, without names, missing values, empty keys or other attributes.

view

complete applied income view, including its exact parent.

replay

one plain nonmissing logical value; if TRUE, replay the complete parent after structural view validation.

Value

Creation returns a closed list with parent_result, selection, data, decisions, summary and applied_lineage, with class liss_clean_collection_applied_result (without liss_clean_result). Validation invisibly returns valid, validation, view_status, source_readiness, parent_source_readiness, parent_analysis_execution_status and replay_status.

Details

Supply explicit ordered unique plain row_keys from parent_result$applied_lineage$row_keys. character(0) selects an empty view. All data columns remain in parent order. Row-dependent names and dimensions follow the natural subset; other column metadata stay exact. The frame keeps its existing guarded class with a distinct versioned applied-view marker.

Decisions retain every parent ledger column, original root row, opaque decision_id and subset row names. Integer root_decision_row is the ordinal in the complete parent ledger; integer view_row is the selected data-row position. Entries are ordered by view_row, then root_decision_row. Stable references use the complete parent digest and root ledger ordinal, without requiring unique decision IDs. Counts refer to selected rows or ledger entries; multiple decisions can refer to one selected data row.

Scoped source readiness is checked against the selected ORIGINAL source frame with its unchanged native receipt, never the corrected output. View projection status, scoped readiness, parent readiness and parent execution status are separate. Empty and other-wave-only selections can be not_evaluated for source scope while parent execution is completed.

Validation reconstructs the closed projection from its complete retained parent and exact selection. With replay = TRUE, it additionally validates and replays the complete parent under liss_validate_applied_income() and its recorded computation/runtime gate. It never refits the selected rows. Whole-view RDS preserves the contract; extracted frames and partial wrappers do not. Whole-parent validation rejects view wrappers. Nested views, repeated cleaning, source rebinding, background attachment, panel/report consumers and SAV/CSV exports are unsupported.

Ordinary SHA-256 hashes (serialization version 2) are not authentication. Coordinated resealing can describe another consistent parent and view. Permitted nonsemantic parent timing changes can pass structure and replay after resealing; no external authenticated parent anchor exists. Replay checks execution outputs under trusted code/runtime, not source authenticity or statistical validity. Removing every recognized claim leaves unknown ownership; aliases cannot recover it.
